newsitem.title: QATAR: Select Qatar shares extend rally in the week.
newsitem.headline: Select Qatar shares extend rally in the week.

text.p: Select shares kept to their recent rally on Qatar's unofficial market in the week to Thursday, pushing the index up another one percent, brokers said.
The 18-share Commercial Bank of Qatar index ended at 119.08 points from 117.82 thanks to sharp gains by market leader Qatar National Bank, Qatar Insurance Co (QIC) and Qatar Flour Mills.
Six shares rose, 11 were stable and one fell in the week.
Qatar National Bank extended the previous week's strong performance, moving up 13 riyals to 580. QIC added 15 riyals to 670 and Qatar Flour was nine riyals, or three percent, stronger at 295.
Qatar General Insurance gathered two riyals to 520. Qatar Cinema and Qatar National Cement Co each added a riyal to 173 and 285 respectively.
Qatar Leisure and Tourism was the only loser in the week, falling two riyals, or over 4.5 percent, to 41 riyals.
